item.title: Swedish police launch probe into possible election fraud around Stockholm
item.description: Police said on Friday they had started preliminary investigations into five complaints of election fraud around Sweden's capital, days after a probe in another area, casting a further shadow over the September 13 national vote.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Police said on Friday they had started preliminary investigations into five complaints of election fraud around Sweden's capital, days after a probe in another area, casting a further shadow over the September 13 [USN:L8N4590Y1 TEXT:"national vote"]. Sweden's [USN:L1N455016 TEXT:"parliamentary election"] saw the opposition narrowly defeat the incumbent right-wing government in a vote widely seen as a referendum on whether the far-right [USN:L1N40K0GO TEXT:"Sweden Democrats"] should be part of the next administration. Stockholm police said they had started the preliminary investigations after receiving five complaints, including one about the vote in the suburb of Jarva. Two of the cases also involved complaints of potential vote-buying, a police spokesperson added, declining to go into more detail or name the other areas. It was not immediately clear what impact those cases might have on the result of the election in those areas if any wrongdoing was found. On Tuesday, prosecutors said they were looking into potential fraud [USN:L1N45E0HN TEXT:"in the central Swedish town of Borlange"], a case that could put 11 parliamentary seats in play if the Election Review Board decides to order a re-run. In a statement on Thursday, the Prosecution Authority said no indictments had been issued in relation to the allegations of fraud in Borlange and no suspects had been formally identified. In that case, the investigation centres on the election of Mohamed Abdukardir Ali, a Left Party candidate for parliament, who unexpectedly overtook other representatives on the ballot for the party. The Left Party said on Tuesday Ali would take a leave of absence while the allegations were being investigated. Reuters was not immediately able to reach Ali for comment. Sweden's Election Review Board on Friday was not immediately available to respond to requests for comment on the new investigations.

item.title: Palmer misses too many England camps, says Tuchel
item.description: England coach Thomas Tuchel said forward Cole Palmer had missed another chance to impress after withdrawing from the squad ahead of Saturday's Nations League opener against Spain with injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England coach Thomas Tuchel said forward Cole Palmer had missed another chance to impress after withdrawing from the squad ahead of Saturday's Nations League opener against Spain with injury. The Chelsea player, who was left out of England's World Cup squad earlier this year after an injury-hit campaign affected his form, returned to Tuchel's plans following a strong start to the season. Palmer has scored four goals and provided two assists in seven appearances for Chelsea so far, earning a recall for Nations League fixtures against Spain, the Czech Republic and Croatia. However, the 24-year-old was forced to pull out of the squad with a muscle problem. "It's another missed opportunity. He misses too many opportunities," Tuchel told reporters. "I don't blame him for it, it's just a fact. He misses way too many camps with injuries. "I only want to rely on what I personally witness and see within my team. For that you have to be in camp. If you are not in camp there is a next level to impress that you cannot achieve because you can only do it with me on the pitch and with us on the pitch. It is a missed opportunity." Tuchel rejected suggestions they were managing the player's workload by letting him leave camp. The Chelsea attacker played the full 90 minutes in his side's defeat by Brentford before reporting for international duty. "He plays with discomfort and pain and cannot play on the highest level with discomfort and pain," Tuchel said. "Chelsea informed us. That is my understanding. We're not managing load. "This is not an international break. It's a competitive environment where the players love to train and be together. That's what we created. We will never compromise on that. "We will never let this feeling creep in that the players don't want to come. We focus on the guys who absolutely want to play for England." The three-week international window is the first under FIFA's revised match calendar, which combines the traditional September and October breaks. England begin their Nations League campaign against world champions Spain at Wembley on Saturday before travelling to Prague to face the Czech Republic on September 29. Tuchel's side then take on Croatia in Rijeka on October 3 before hosting the Czechs at Wembley three nights later in Group A3.

item.title: Allemagne AfD et CDU unis pour interdire à Heidenau la pose de plaques commémoratives de l'Holocauste
item.description: La ville d'Heidenau, dans l'est de l'Allemagne, a approuvé une motion du parti d'extrême droite Alternative pour l'Allemagne (AfD) et de l'Union chrétienne-démocrate (CDU) interdisant la future pose au sol de plaques commémoratives des victimes de l'Holocauste.
item.dc:creator: Emanuele Berro, Friederike Heine
item.content:encoded: La ville d'Heidenau, dans l'est de l'Allemagne, a approuvé une motion du parti d'extrême droite Alternative pour l'Allemagne (AfD) et de l'Union chrétienne-démocrate (CDU) interdisant la future pose au sol de plaques commémoratives des victimes de l'Holocauste. Les "Stolpersteine" (littéralement "pierres sur lesquelles on trébuche") sont des pavés mémoriels créés dans les années 90 par l'artiste berlinois Gunter Demnig en hommage aux victimes du nazisme. On en trouve dans plusieurs villes d'Allemagne mais aussi dans d'autres pays européens. La décision prise jeudi à Heidenau, une ville située près de Dresde, dans le Land de Saxe, intervient alors que l’AfD devance la CDU du chancelier au pouvoir Friedrich Merz dans les sondages nationaux après des succès régionaux. L’AfD a souvent remis en cause la mémoire de l’Holocauste en Allemagne. Le cofondateur du parti, Alexander Gauland, a notamment qualifié l’époque nazie de simple "fiente d’oiseau" dans l'Histoire allemande. Le conseil municipal de Heidenau a décidé que les futures commémorations se concentreraient sur un site situé dans le cimetière nord de la ville. Cette décision a relancé le débat sur le respect par la CDU du "Brandmauer", un principe de "mur coupe-feu" informel selon lequel les principaux partis allemands excluent toute coopération officielle avec l’AfD. Les sections locales de l’AfD et de la CDU n’ont pas répondu aux demandes de commentaires de Reuters dans l'immédiat. "Je suis consternée qu’un parti démocratique ait choisi de soutenir une manœuvre aussi transparente de la part de l’AfD extrémiste", a déploré Charlotte Knobloch, présidente d’une association juive de Bavière, au groupe de presse Funke. L’adoption de la motion allait à l’encontre d’une recommandation de l’administration municipale. "Une interdiction générale des futurs Stolpersteine n’est ni nécessaire à la création d’un mémorial central, ni justifiée par la proposition elle-même", avait déclaré l’administration municipale dans un communiqué avant la décision. Les partisans de la motion ont fait valoir que de nombreux habitants considéraient les "Stolpersteine" comme inappropriés car les passants peuvent marcher dessus.

item.title: Os maiores ataques e roubos no mundo das criptomoedas
item.description: A corretora de criptomoedas Bitget afirmou nesta sexta-feira que criptomoedas no valor aproximado de US$350 milhões foram roubadas da plataforma.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A corretora de criptomoedas Bitget afirmou nesta sexta-feira que criptomoedas no valor aproximado de US$350 milhões foram roubadas da plataforma. No ano passado, invasores roubaram US$2,9 bilhões em criptomoedas em quase 150 ataques diferentes, segundo pesquisadores da TRM Labs. Autoridades alertaram em julho que grupos do crime organizado utilizam criptomoedas para transferir fundos rapidamente entre países, sem recorrer ao sistema financeiro convencional. Aqui estão alguns dos maiores roubos desde que o bitcoin surgiu, em 2008. BYBIT Um valor recorde de US$1,5 bilhão em criptomoedas ether foi roubado da corretora Bybit em fevereiro de 2025, no que os pesquisadores consideraram o maior roubo de moedas digitais até o momento. A polícia federal dos Estados Unidos (FBI) afirmou que a Coreia do Norte foi a responsável e que os fundos foram rapidamente convertidos em outras criptomoedas e, em seguida, dispersos por milhares de endereços em várias blockchains. A Coreia do Norte negou ter organizado roubos de criptomoedas. POLY NETWORK Hackers roubaram da Poly Network, uma plataforma que facilita transações de tokens ponto a ponto, cerca de US$610 milhões em agosto de 2021. Os hackers responsáveis pelo roubo devolveram posteriormente quase todos os recursos roubados. RONIN NETWORK Em março de 2022, hackers roubaram criptomoedas no valor de cerca de US$540 milhões na época de um projeto de blockchain vinculado ao popular jogo online Axie Infinity. A Ronin, uma rede que permite a transferência de criptomoedas entre diferentes blockchains, informou que os hackers roubaram cerca de 173.600 tokens de ether e 25,5 milhões de tokens de USD Coin. COINCHECK Em janeiro de 2018, hackers roubaram da corretora Coincheck, com sede em Tóquio, cerca de US$530 milhões em criptomoedas, segundo valores da época . Os ladrões atacaram uma das “hot wallets” da Coincheck, uma carteira digital armazenada online, para drenar os fundos. A agência de inteligência da Coreia do Sul afirmou na época que um grupo de hackers norte-coreano poderia estar por trás do roubo. MT. GOX Em um dos primeiros e mais notórios ataques envolvendo criptomoedas, bitcoins no valor de quase US$500 milhões foram roubados da corretora Mt.Gox, em Tóquio, na época a maior do mundo, entre 2011 e 2014. A Mt.Gox, que já havia movimentado 80% do comércio mundial de bitcoins, entrou com pedido de recuperação judicial no início de 2014 após a revelação do ataque, fazendo com que cerca de 24 mil clientes perdessem o acesso aos seus recursos. (Por Tommy Reggiori Wilkes e Tom Wilson)

item.title: Italy's Eni caps fuel prices as Meloni struggles to tame rising costs
item.description: Italian state-controlled energy group Eni on Friday said it would cap fuel pump prices for at least one month, supporting Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's efforts to curb energy costs.
item.dc:creator: Francesca Landini
item.content:encoded: Italian state-controlled energy group Eni (ENI.MI) on Friday said it would cap fuel pump prices for at least one month, supporting Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's efforts to curb energy costs. Eni said its Enilive unit would sell diesel at no more than €2.19 per litre and petrol at no more than €1.99 per litre, starting from Monday, saying it represented a discount of around 17 cents from current average prices. "The government thanks Eni for the important initiative," Meloni's office said in a statement, calling it "a commendable gesture of consideration for Italy." The price cap will be valid for an initial period of 30 days, with the possibility of extending it through the end of the year, depending on market and supply trends, the company said. Meloni's administration has repeatedly renewed temporary cuts in fuel excise duties in recent months, spending around €2.8 billion, when also including tax breaks for truck drivers. The latest cut of around 12 cents per litre applies only to diesel and expires on Friday. It is set to be reduced to around 6 cents per litre from September 26 to October 5. Eni noted that geopolitical crises, combined with a shortage in Europe's refining capacity, had "driven fuel prices to levels that are extremely burdensome for Italian households and businesses." It presented its price cap decision as "a further gesture of solidarity toward the country, consumers, and its customers," saying it had already refrained from fully passing on cost increases to consumers. The National Consumers Union also praised Eni's move, while suggesting that it could persuade the government to back off from mooted plans to introduce a windfall tax on energy companies. Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti has said he would prefer a coordinated move at the EU level but has not ruled out a domestic windfall tax, as the government prepares the 2027 budget law, to be unveiled next month.

item.title: EFL seeks £1 billion from Premier League over five years, Sky reports
item.description: The English Football League has asked for payment of £1 billion ($1.3 billion) over five years from the Premier League amid ongoing negotiations for a new revenue-sharing deal in English football, Sky News reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The English Football League has asked for payment of £1 billion ($1.3 billion) over five years from the Premier League amid ongoing negotiations for a new revenue-sharing deal in English football, Sky News reported on Friday. Premier League clubs were told at a meeting on Thursday that the EFL was seeking annual payments of £207 million over five years, the report added. Media reports said earlier this year that the Premier League had proposed paying £1.5 billion over 10 years, in addition to existing funding provided by the top flight. An EFL spokesperson declined to comment on the matter, citing ongoing discussions. Reuters has contacted the Premier League for comment. Media reports said that the Premier League paid around £137 million to the three lower leagues under the EFL umbrella last season, including the second-tier Championship, League One and League Two. ($1 = 0.7556 pounds)

item.title: Western miners can match China’s speed if African governments cut red tape, KoBold president says
item.description: The top executive of KoBold Metals said Western miners can match China's pace in developing critical minerals projects in Africa without compromising compliance standards as long as governments streamline approvals and improve coordination among regulators.
item.dc:creator: Maxwell Adombila, Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo
item.content:encoded: The top executive of KoBold Metals said Western miners can match China's pace in developing critical minerals projects in Africa without compromising compliance standards as long as governments streamline approvals and improve coordination among regulators. California-based KoBold, an exploration firm backed by US billionaires Jeff Bezos and Bill Gates, argues that these steps would allow Western investors to deploy capital faster and compete more effectively with Chinese rivals for Africa's critical minerals. "We reject the assertion that you can't go fast and do things right. You can do both," KoBold President Josh Goldman told Reuters on Monday. [USN:L8N3Z21F6 TEXT:"Competition for Africa's"] critical minerals is intensifying as the US, Europe and China race to secure supplies of metals vital for electric vehicles, artificial intelligence and defence technologies. From Democratic Republic of Congo to Guinea, Chinese firms have often outpaced Western rivals through rapid execution, navigating bureaucratic processes and backing mines with railways, ports and processing plants. KoBold is seeking faster exploration approvals in Namibia while expanding lithium and copper exploration in Congo, Goldman said. "We would like to accelerate our investment (in Namibia) because we like the rocks, the operating environment, the jurisdiction and the people, but we need to be able to go faster," he said before meeting the country's ministers of international trade and agriculture in New York on Thursday on the company's concerns. Namibia's Presidency and the ministries of international relations and agriculture did not immediately respond to requests for comment. KoBold, which has invested about $2 million in Namibia since 2022, holds more than 7,000 square kilometres of exploration licenses there, its largest land position globally by area. In Congo, KoBold is advancing what Goldman described as the country's largest lithium exploration program, alongside a [USN:L8N40W1T0 TEXT:"major copper exploration"] campaign near the Zambian border as it searches for a world-class discovery comparable to the Manono deposit. Goldman said the effort was not being slowed by the long-running dispute surrounding Manono, where [USN:L4N3SR01H TEXT:"Australia's AVZ Minerals"] (3A2.H) and Chinese interests remain locked in competing claims. "Finding the next Manono doesn't depend on what happens with the known deposits," he said. China's Zijin Mining (601899.SS) began lithium exports from an [USN:L8N43H16J TEXT:"adjoining block at Manono"] in June after building supporting infrastructure, Reuters reported.

item.title: U2 mark 50 years together with concert at school where it all began
item.description: U2 marked 50 years as a band on Friday by returning to the school where they started playing together as teenagers and delighted current students with a concert featuring hits such as 'With Or Without You', 'One' and 'Beautiful Day'.
item.dc:creator: Padraic Halpin
item.content:encoded: U2 marked 50 years as a band on Friday by returning to the school where they started playing together as teenagers and delighted current students with a concert featuring hits such as 'With Or Without You', 'One' and 'Beautiful Day'. The 22-time Grammy-Award-winning band formed in September 1976 after Larry Mullen Jr. pinned a handwritten note reading "Drummer Seeks Musicians To Form Band" on the notice board at Mount Temple Comprehensive School in north Dublin. Mullen, Bono, The Edge and Adam Clayton on Friday sought to replicate one of their early shows when they played on the roof of the school's boiler room in 1978, the start of a journey that would carve their place in rock history. Hundreds of students, some holding hand-drawn posters saying "It's A Beautiful Day No School", finished class early and packed the school yard, where they screamed throughout the 35-minute set alongside their similarly enthusiastic teachers. "Is that the science lab?" said Bono, dressed all in black, as he arrived on stage and pointed to a building in the distance where some teachers watched out of windows and recorded the scene on their phones. Fans also gathered to listen outside the school gates after word of the secret show spread. After arriving on stage as Alice Cooper's 'School's Out' blared from the speakers, the band launched into a seven-song set that spanned 'I Will Follow' and 'Out Of Control' from their 1980 debut 'Boy' to 'Vertigo', a UK No. 1 single 24 years later. Around 30 students from a local music education programme joined on violins, viola and harps for the rendition of 'One'. U2, whose most renowned albums include 'The Joshua Tree' and 'Achtung Baby', announced this week the release of their 16th album 'Carnaval De Luz' on November 13. The album, their first in nine years, will feature a duet between Bono and the late Dolly Parton in what the band said was the country singer's last vocal performance. Friday's set also included a live airing of new single 'Silencio'. Bono thanked the teachers from the "rock 'n' roll high school", some of whom were in the crowd, who helped shape their creativity. "This island is full of song and music and mischief and we're so proud to be Irish," he said.

item.title: Gucci's Demna blends aristocracy and pop culture at Milan Fashion Week
item.description: Gucci designer Demna on Friday unveiled what he described as his first complete personal vision for the brand, presenting pagoda-shouldered tailoring and cropped, puff-shaped outerwear, as the Kering-owned label seeks to revive growth after a prolonged downturn.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gucci designer Demna on Friday unveiled what he described as his first complete personal vision for the brand, presenting pagoda-shouldered tailoring and cropped, puff-shaped outerwear, as the Kering-owned label seeks to revive growth after a prolonged downturn. In what Gucci called "The store show", models walked through a series of neutral tone retail-inspired rooms, a setting the brand said offered a glimpse of how Demna's aesthetic could shape Gucci stores in the future. The show, Demna's third, presented men's and women's collections sequentially. Former Balenciaga's Demna was appointed Gucci's creative director in March 2025, effective from July, taking over the creative helm of the Kering-owned label after the departure of Sabato De Sarno. "Gucci moves easily between aristocracy and pop culture, Florence and Hollywood, good taste and bad taste (whatever that means), heritage and mass desire, belonging and rebellion, and the interplay between the two", Demna said. Sales at Gucci [USN:L6N43U118 TEXT:"fell 3%"] in the second quarter, less than expected, as strong US demand for its new handbags partly offset weaker spending elsewhere, suggesting the group's turnaround efforts may be gaining traction. Reuters reported this week that Gucci has begun selling new luxury sneaker models [USN:L6N45D0BT TEXT:"labelled "Made in China""], in a break with its Italian manufacturing tradition. Some industry watchers say could undermine the brand's high-end image as it races to win back middle-class shoppers. Milan Fashion Week, which opened on Tuesday with Prada's show, runs through Sunday. The schedule still includes presentations from Dolce & Gabbana, Bottega Veneta and Giorgio Armani.

item.title: Florida's Brightline railroad lines up $490 million for bankruptcy restructuring
item.description: Florida's Brightline commuter railroad said Friday that it has lined up $490 million in new financing to restructure some of its parent company debt, while leaving other bond debt untouched.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: Florida's Brightline commuter railroad said Friday that it has lined up $490 million in new financing to restructure some of its parent company debt, while leaving other bond debt untouched. 17 Brightline affiliates filed for Chapter 11 in New Jersey late Thursday. Brightline Trains Florida LLC, the train operating company, will remain outside of bankruptcy. Brightline said the debt restructuring will not impact $2.2 billion in bond debt that was used to finance the company's rail construction. Brightline operates a high-speed Miami-to-Orlando private rail line. The debt restructuring will allow the rail company to re-invest in operations and capitalize on "real momentum," Brightline CEO Patrick Goddard said. Ridership is up 14% from last year and revenue is up 17%, according to Brightline. Bankruptcy petitions list over $1 billion in assets and over $1 billion in liabilities.

item.title: Huracán Polo vuelve a fortalecerse a medida que se aleja de costa mexicana
item.description: El huracán Polo volvió a fortalecerse el viernes y alcanzó la categoría 5, la máxima escala en la potencia de vientos, a medida que se iba alejando de la costa occidental de Mexico e internando en el océano Pacífico, dijo el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (NHC, por su sigla en inglés) de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Dante Alfaro
item.content:encoded: El huracán Polo volvió a fortalecerse el viernes y alcanzó la categoría 5, la máxima escala en la potencia de vientos, a medida que se iba alejando de la costa occidental de Mexico e internando en el océano Pacífico, dijo el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (NHC, por su sigla en inglés) de Estados Unidos. A las 8.00 hora local (1400 GMT) Polo se ubicaba a unos 470 kilómetros al suroeste de Cabo Corrientes, un pequeño municipio costero del estado Jalisco, y soplaba vientos máximos sostenidos de 285 kilómetros por hora (km/h), con rachas más fuertes, mientras se desplazaba hacia el oeste a 19 km/h, indicó el NHC. A su paso, dejaba lluvias torrenciales, vientos fuertes y oleaje anómalo. En la semana, el azote del ciclón obligó a las autoridades a [USN:L6N45G1AV TEXT:"evacuar a decenas de personas"] a refugios temporales, [USN:L6N45F0UV TEXT:"cerrar puertos"] y cancelar clases escolares. En el pequeño poblado costero El Paraíso, en el estado Colima, el mar embravecido arrastró piedras hacia calles cercanas a la playa y provocó daños materiales. "Tenemos afectaciones por el huracán", reconoció Efrén Pacheco, comisario de El Paraíso, cuya playa se abarrota en verano por turistas que practican diversos deportes acuáticos como surf y windsurf. "Gracias a Dios, daños a personas no tenemos, pero sí tenemos bastantes daños materiales. Se sienten todavía los efectos del huracán. El mar no le ha bajado, ha estado fuerte", relató mientras se guarecía de una terca lluvia. Se espera que Polo vire durante el fin de semana hacia el norte y, por primera vez, toque tierra el lunes como un huracán de categoría 2 en la Península de Baja California, cerca del popular destino turístico La Paz. 24 horas más tarde, tocaría tierra por segunda vez cerca de Ciudad Obregón, la segunda ciudad más poblada del estado Sonora. Aunque se pronostica que Polo perderá algo de intensidad a medida que se acerque y atraviese el noroeste de México, seguirá siendo peligroso, provocando vientos potencialmente dañinos, marejada ciclónica y lluvias torrenciales. "Polo es un huracán de categoría 5 extremadamente poderoso", advirtió el NHC. "Los residentes de Baja California Sur deben seguir de cerca su trayectoria", agregó. AccuWeather, una compañía estadounidense que presta servicios comerciales de pronóstico del tiempo, estimó que el ciclón podría provocar inundaciones repentinas y condiciones meteorológicas adversas en el centro-sur de Estados Unidos a finales de la próxima semana, tras amenazar a México como un poderoso huracán con vientos dañinos, lluvias torrenciales y mares peligrosos durante el fin de semana.

item.title: Corte Suprema de EEUU restablece el sistema de verificación masiva de votantes de Trump
item.description: La Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos reactivó el viernes una base de datos sobre inmigración que, según el Gobierno del presidente Donald Trump, tiene como objetivo combatir el voto de personas que no son ciudadanas, pero que los críticos sostienen que podría privar del sufragio a personas con derecho.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: La Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos reactivó el viernes una base de datos sobre inmigración que, según el Gobierno del presidente Donald Trump, tiene como objetivo combatir el voto de personas que no son ciudadanas, pero que los críticos sostienen que podría privar del sufragio a personas con derecho. Los magistrados aceptaron la solicitud del Departamento de Justicia de bloquear la orden de un juez que impidió a los funcionarios estatales usar los números de la Seguridad Social y otros datos para hacer comprobaciones exhaustivas de la condición de ciudadanía de los votantes inscritos cotejándola con los registros federales. El acuerdo de intercambio de datos gubernamental forma parte de una serie de medidas que refuerzan la implicación del Gobierno federal en el proceso electoral antes de los comicios legislativos de noviembre, en los que el Partido Republicano de Trump busca mantener el control del Congreso. La Constitución otorga a cada estado la autoridad principal para organizar y administrar las elecciones. El Departamento de Seguridad Nacional rediseñó el año pasado una base de datos federal conocida como "Verificación sistemática de extranjeros para prestaciones» (SAVE, por sus siglas en inglés), usada para verificar la ciudadanía y la situación migratoria de una persona. Desde entonces, varios estados gobernados por republicanos han cotejado sus listas electorales con la base de datos, y a algunos votantes señalados como posibles no ciudadanos se les ha cancelado su inscripción. Los críticos dicen que estas medidas de los republicanos no responden tanto a preocupaciones por la seguridad electoral como a un intento de obtener ventaja política reduciendo el electorado, con el riesgo de privar del voto a ciudadanos con derecho a ello que, a menudo, se inclinan por el Partido Demócrata. Los grupos que presentaron una demanda para bloquear el sistema SAVE revisado afirmaron que el nuevo enfoque ha provocado que personas identificadas erróneamente como no ciudadanos hayan sido eliminadas de las listas electorales. Argumentan que el sistema SAVE puede estar desactualizado, lo que significa que los inmigrantes que se han naturalizado como ciudadanos estadounidenses y, por lo tanto, tienen derecho a votar, a veces son etiquetados como no ciudadanos. La tasa de error global del sistema modificado no se conoce públicamente. Ni el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional ni el de Justicia facilitaron la información cuando se les solicitó. En su escrito presentado ante la Suprema, los grupos de derechos civiles citaron a un funcionario electoral del condado de Travis, en el estado de Texas, quien afirmó que el 25% de las coincidencias de no ciudadanos detectadas por el sistema en esa zona correspondían a personas que ya habían demostrado su ciudadanía estadounidense. También se refirió a informes periodísticos que revelaron que al menos el 81% de las respuestas del sistema en el condado de San Luis, en el estado de Misuri, eran erróneas. En una sentencia de junio que bloqueaba la base de datos renovada, la jueza federal de distrito Sparkle Sooknanan, en Washington D. C., señaló que el sistema se elaboró de forma descuidada y contenía datos de ciudadanía poco fiables. "En definitiva, el Gobierno federal ha pisoteado a sabiendas los derechos de privacidad de los ciudadanos estadounidenses de una manera que amenaza el derecho sagrado al voto", escribió Sooknanan. "Este tribunal no puede quedarse de brazos cruzados mientras eso ocurre". El Tribunal de Apelación para el Circuito del Distrito de Columbia, en una sentencia de 2 a 1 dictada el 4 de septiembre, se negó a suspender la resolución de Sooknanan, lo que llevó al Gobierno a presentar un recurso ante la Suprema .

item.title: ONS vê chuvas acima da média em hidrelétricas do Sul e Sudeste/Centro-Oeste em outubro
item.description: As chuvas que deverão chegar às usinas hidrelétricas em outubro deverão ficar acima da média de longo prazo nos subsistemas Sul e Sudeste/Centro-Oeste, segundo estimativas do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As chuvas que deverão chegar às usinas hidrelétricas em outubro deverão ficar acima da média de longo prazo nos subsistemas Sul e Sudeste/Centro-Oeste, segundo estimativas do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS). Em boletim nesta sexta-feira, o ONS projetou afluências em 193% da média histórica para as hidrelétricas no Sul do país, enquanto no subsistema Sudeste/Centro-Oeste as precipitações devem ficar em 105% da média. No restante do país, as estimativas são de chuvas em 61% da média no Nordeste e 43% no Norte. Com as afluências ainda favoráveis, os principais reservatórios de hidrelétricas do país, concentrados no subsistema Sudeste/Centro-Oeste, deverão encerrar o mês de outubro em 55,6% da capacidade, ante nível de 57,4% registrado nesta sexta-feira, projetou o ONS. Já a carga de energia elétrica no Brasil deve aumentar 3,6% em outubro na comparação anual, para 85.274 megawatts médios.

item.title: AI messaging scam costs Italy's top bank Intesa millions, sources say
item.description: Fraudsters using AI to impersonate senior executives stole €95 million ($108 million) from Fideuram, the private banking arm of Italy's biggest lender Intesa Sanpaolo , two sources familiar with the matter said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Emilio Parodi
item.content:encoded: Fraudsters using AI to impersonate senior executives stole €95 million ($108 million) from Fideuram, the private banking arm of Italy's biggest lender Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) , two sources familiar with the matter said on Friday. More than half the funds were later recovered, but some €36 million remains missing, the sources said. The scheme, first reported by Corriere della Sera, began in February when then-Fideuram Chairman Paolo Molesini received what appeared to be a WhatsApp message from Intesa Sanpaolo CEO Carlo Messina seeking urgent help with an overseas transaction. The fraudsters followed up with a phone call that appeared to come from a senior partner at a prominent law firm, confirming the instruction. According to the sources, the callers used AI technology to replicate the lawyer's voice. Believing the request was genuine, Molesini instructed his finance department to arrange a series of transfers to foreign accounts, mainly in China and Hong Kong, the sources said. Intesa Sanpaolo and Fideuram declined to comment. Fideuram quickly detected irregularities in the transfers and alerted banks and authorities in several countries. Roughly €53 million was later recovered through cooperation between authorities in China, Portugal and Italy, according to the sources. The remaining funds have not been traced after passing through a network of overseas accounts and being converted into cryptocurrencies, they said. Neither Molesini nor any other Fideuram executives are under investigation, the sources said. However, Milan prosecutors have placed a foreign national living outside Europe under investigation on suspicion of computer fraud, one of the sources said. Molesini resigned as chairman in March citing personal reasons. At the time, Fideuram gave no further explanation for his departure. Last year, [USN:L1N3P313U TEXT:"fraudsters using AI"] to mimic the voice of an Italian minister persuaded businessman Massimo Moratti to transfer nearly €1 million to an overseas account. The money was later recovered. ($1 = 0.8772 euros)

item.title: Truckers, commuters protest in Portugal against soaring fuel prices
item.description: Hundreds of truckers took part in a "go-slow" convoy along a motorway in north-central Portugal on Friday, while commuters blared their horns on Lisbon's main bridge to protest against soaring fuel costs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hundreds of truckers took part in a "go-slow" convoy along a motorway in north-central Portugal on Friday, while commuters blared their horns on Lisbon's main bridge to protest against soaring fuel costs. Fuel prices have reached all-time highs in Portugal due to supply disruptions related to the Iran war and refinery attacks linked to the war in Ukraine. Prices at the pump increased 24% in August year-on-year, with diesel hitting more than €2 ($2.28) per litre, according to Eurostat data. Trucks slowly rolled along the A1 motorway in a 150-km (93-mile) convoy from Paredes in the north to the central Portuguese city of Coimbra. Demonstrators demanded eligibility for the partial refunds of the tax on petroleum products enjoyed by freight and passenger transport companies. Video from state broadcaster RTP showed a truck leading the convoy bearing a sign reading: "Today, the trucks are stopping — but their importance isn't." Speaking to reporters in Cascais, Minister of Infrastructure and Housing Miguel Pinto Luz acknowledged the trucking industry had been "overlooked in some ways" in the measures taken so far to limit the impact of rising fuel prices. He pledged to review their proposals and scheduled a meeting with the movement's representatives at the ministry next Monday. In Lisbon, commuters launched a honking protest at 8 a.m. local time (0700 GMT) while crossing the April 25 bridge, which connects the capital to the working-class outskirts on the southern bank of the Tagus river. They called for the reinstatement of remote working — a policy temporarily applied during the COVID-19 pandemic – as well as the suspension of toll payments and the 23% value-added tax on fuel, Aristides Teixeira, spokesperson of the Ponte 25 de Abril Users' Association, told Lusa. The group also seeks the resignation of Environment Minister Maria Graça Carvalho over comments in which she suggested citizens drive more slowly to reduce their fuel consumption. ($1 = 0.8779 euros)

item.title: Man City's road from Premier League financial charges to reported verdict
item.description: The following is a timeline of Manchester City's Premier League financial rules case, from the charges brought in February 2023 to reports on Friday that the club had been found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The following is a timeline of Manchester City's Premier League financial rules case, from the charges brought in February 2023 to reports on Friday that the club had been [USN:L1N45H0FI TEXT:"found guilty"] of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches. February 6, 2023 The Premier League refers City to an independent commission over [USN:L4N34M29T TEXT:"more than 100 alleged breaches"] of finance rules. City were alleged to have committed [USN:L4N34N0N7 TEXT:"multiple financial breaches"] such as failing to provide accurate financial information, Financial Fair Play breaches, failure to cooperate with investigations, breaching profitability and sustainability regulations and failure to report contracts. February 10, 2023 City manager Pep Guardiola says the club have already been '[USN:L1N34Q1CB TEXT:"condemned"]' after being charged by the Premier League. "It's the same as what happened after UEFA (charges), these are just charges. With UEFA the club proved it was completely innocent. We are lucky we live in a marvellous country where everyone is innocent until proven guilty," Guardiola said. May 24, 2023 Guardiola says he would like the financial charges against the club to be dealt with "as soon as possible" after City secured a fifth league title in six seasons under the Spaniard. "Let's go. Don't wait two years. Why don't we do it quicker? In 24 hours, sit down with lawyers present. Let's have it as soon as possible for the benefit of everyone," he said. June 19, 2023 City Chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak said the club were frustrated by the situation, saying it detracted from the achievements of the team after they achieved a treble. "I hope people focus and judge them (the players) for their football, what they're achieving on the pitch and what they're achieving in every competition they're in," he said. November 15, 2023 City say they earned revenues of 712.8 million pounds ($876.17 million) to June 2023 -- an increase of 99.8 million (16.3%) over the previous season, along with a record net profit of 80.4 million pounds. November 17, 2023 Everton become the first Premier League team to be [USN:L4N3CI2H4 TEXT:"deducted points"] for breaching Profitability and Sustainability Rules (PSR) when the league docked the Merseyside club 10 points over their finances in the 2020-21 season. The Commission determined that Everton's PSR calculation for the relevant period resulted in a loss of 124.5 million pounds -- which exceeded the threshold of 105 million pounds permitted under PSRs. January 15, 2024 Nottingham Forest also face points deductions after being charged by the Premier League for a breach of their PSRs. January 16, 2024 Premier League CEO Richard Masters tells the Culture, Media and Sport (CMS) Committee of the UK Parliament that a hearing date has been set for City's financial rule breach charges. "There is a date set for that proceeding. Unfortunately, I can't tell you when that is but it is progressing," Masters said. February 26, 2024 Everton have their points deduction for breaching Premier League financial rules [USN:L3N3FB2Z4 TEXT:"reduced to six points"] from 10 on appeal. March 18, 2024 Forest are plunged into the relegation zone after having [USN:L5N3FW4KT TEXT:"four points deducted"] for breaking financial rules in the 2022-23 season. The club had admitted breaching the threshold of 61 million pounds by 34.5 million. March 21, 2024 Leicester City also face a points deduction after the Premier League refers the 2015-16 champions to an independent commission over alleged breaches of the league's spending rules. April 8, 2024 Everton are docked two more points by the Premier League -- their second points deduction of the season -- after an independent commission found they had breached the league PSRs. May 7, 2024 Forest are [USN:L1N3HA154 TEXT:"unsuccessful in their appeal"] to overturn their four-point deduction but the club eventually survives relegation, finishing six points above the drop zone. May 10, 2024 Everton [USN:L4N3HD2V9 TEXT:"withdraw their appeal"] against the two-point deduction after the team secure their top-flight status. They eventually finish 15th in the standings. September 3, 2024 Leicester City [USN:L8N3KL1N2 TEXT:"win an appeal"] against a decision that could have led to a points deduction for an alleged breach of PSRs on the basis that an independent commission ruling on the case did not have jurisdiction. Leicester's accounting period ended on June 30, 2023, when the club was no longer a member of the Premier League following relegation to the second tier the previous month. September 16, 2024 Hearing into City's alleged violations of the Premier League's financial regulations begins. Held by an independent commission comprised of three judges, it is estimated to last 10 weeks. October 7, 2024 In a [USN:L4N3LJ0ZP TEXT:"separate independent hearing"], both City and the Premier League claimed victory after an arbitration panel ruled on sponsorship deals, known as Associated Party Transactions (APT), that the club was blocked from completing. December 6, 2024 Hearing into City's alleged violations concludes, with a decision expected in early 2025. February 8, 2025 Guardiola said he expected a verdict "in one month", days after City had spent around 190 million pounds on new players in the January transfer window. August 13, 2025 Ahead of the 2025-26 season, Masters says they have no influence over the decision and cannot speculate on the timings of the case. "Legal processes rarely take less time than anticipated. We have to be patient," he told Sky Sports. May 22, 2026 [USN:L1N41Z0BT TEXT:"Guardiola announces he will leave City"] at the end of the 2025-26 season, bringing to a close a decade in charge that delivered one of the most successful eras in English soccer. June 29, 2026 City appoint former Chelsea boss [USN:L6N4310RP TEXT:"Enzo Maresca"] as manager from the 2026-27 season, tasking the Italian with building on the success achieved under Guardiola. August 18, 2026 [USN:L4N44F13J TEXT:"Masters acknowledged growing frustration"] over the delay in a verdict on the alleged charges against City, saying the process had taken longer than expected. September 25, 2026 City were found guilty of all but one of the 115 alleged breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, The Athletic and The Times reported on Friday. The club are expected to appeal, the reports added. The Premier League declined to comment. "It's a confidential process, we're not commenting at all," a spokesperson said. City did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment, but told the BBC that the inquiry into allegations "remains ongoing."

item.title: Importante prêmio literário francês tira romance da competição após autor ser acusado de usar IA
item.description: Os organizadores do prestigioso Prêmio Literário Goncourt, da França, anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que retiraram da lista de indicados um romance de grande sucesso do autor haitiano-canadense Thelyson Orelien, após acusações de que ele teria usado inteligência artificial para escrevê-lo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os organizadores do prestigioso Prêmio Literário Goncourt, da França, anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que retiraram da lista de indicados um romance de grande sucesso do autor haitiano-canadense Thelyson Orelien, após acusações de que ele teria usado inteligência artificial para escrevê-lo. Orelien negou ter usado IA para escrever “C’était Ça ou Mourir” (“Era Isso ou Morrer”), enquanto as alegações desencadearam um debate sobre raça, mérito literário e originalidade que agitou o meio literário francês. As acusações sobre o uso da IA foram feitas nesta semana por uma conta pouco conhecida no X chamada “Balance ton Claude”. O ensaísta Samuel Fitoussi posteriormente assumiu a autoria da conta, afirmando que a administrava junto com outras pessoas não identificadas. As acusações sobre uso de IA foram seguidas por reportagens de que Orelien havia cometido plágio em obras anteriores. O jornal La Presse afirmou que um conto de Orelien, de 2012, havia plagiado trechos de um livro do autor francês Louis Pauwels, enquanto um artigo de opinião de 2013 havia sido copiado do jornal The Philippine Star. Orelien ainda não se pronunciou sobre essas acusações e não respondeu a um pedido de comentário nesta sexta-feira. A Academia Goncourt, com sede em Paris, afirmou ter tomado conhecimento das acusações relacionadas ao uso de IA e ao plágio e decidiu retirar o romance de Orelien “para preservar a integridade do Prêmio Goncourt e da Academia, cujo papel central é promover e homenagear a literatura escrita por mulheres e homens”. A Academia afirmou que espera que sua decisão demonstre que se opõe totalmente à “criação de textos gerados com o auxílio da IA”, acrescentando que não fará mais comentários antes de 6 de outubro, quando anunciará sua lista de finalistas. O romance de estreia do autor nascido no Haiti conta a história de um imigrante haitiano que viaja para o norte pela América Latina antes de chegar ao Canadá. A obra já ganhou diversos outros prêmios literários e deveria ser traduzida para vários idiomas. Suas editoras francesa e canadense inicialmente ofereceram a Orelien total apoio em relação às alegações sobre uso de IA. Elas não responderam aos pedidos de comentário nesta sexta-feira. O “Balance ton Claude” afirmou que a análise de trechos do romance pela ferramenta de detecção de IA Pangram mostrou que a obra “foi escrita quase inteiramente por inteligência artificial”. Alguns especialistas afirmam que a confiabilidade das ferramentas de detecção de IA é questionável. (Reportagem de Gabriel Stargardter e Mateusz Rabiega)

item.title: Senegal debut for Vieira ends in disappointing draw
item.description: Patrick Vieira's debut as Senegal coach ended in a frustrating 1-1 draw away in Mozambique on Friday as they let slip a first-half lead and ended up sharing the points in their opening Africa Cup of Nations qualifier.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gleeson
item.content:encoded: Patrick Vieira's debut as Senegal coach ended in a frustrating 1-1 draw away in Mozambique on Friday as they let slip a first-half lead and ended up sharing the points in their opening Africa Cup of Nations qualifier. Much was expected of the former World Cup winner's first game in charge despite a much-changed side after a disappointing World Cup for Senegal, where they went out in the last 32 after an underwhelming and error-ridden campaign. But while Nicholas Jackson pounced on some poor defending to hand Senegal a 32nd-minute lead in Maputo, they allowed Geny Catamo to equalise for the hosts, hitting a rasping shot from outside the penalty area in first-half stoppage time. Vieira's new-look team was without goalkeeper Edouard Mendy, who has retired, and veteran centre-back Kalidou Koulibaly, whose international career also looks at an end, plus injured Sadio Mane. Senegal were still expected to win but came up against a highly motivated home team in an exciting tussle with chances at either end. Also in Group J on Friday, Mohammed Mamon struck four minutes from time to hand Sudan a 1-0 win over neighbours Ethiopia. The two former African champions were playing the match in Juba, South Sudan because of the security situation caused by the civil war in Sudan. Guinea-Bissau opened their Group L campaign with a 2-0 win away over Tanzania in Zanzibar City with goals in either half from Franculino Dju and Mame Balde. Tanzania are one of three co-hosts of next June's Cup of Nations finals but along with Kenya and Uganda are also participating in the qualifying competition. The top two finishers in each of the 12 groups advance to the finals except in the groups where the hosts are playing, from which only one other team will qualify. Friday's extensive list of qualifiers also has past winners Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and Zambia all in action.

item.title: Seventh person killed by bear in Russian region in a month as spate of attacks grows
item.description: A Russian woman has been fatally mauled by a bear in her garden, the seventh such death in her Siberian region this month, state investigators said, amid a nationwide spate of killings that experts blame on climate change and human incompetence.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Osborn
item.content:encoded: A Russian woman has been fatally mauled by a bear in her garden, the seventh such death in her Siberian region this month, state investigators said, amid a nationwide spate of killings that experts blame on climate change and human incompetence. A video released by investigators in Siberia's Krasnoyarsk region some 3,000 km (1,864 miles) east of Moscow showed them walking through a wooded area and inspecting the corpse of the brown bear which carried out the attack. The state TASS news agency said the bear had killed the 51-year-old woman in the village of Voznesenka after she saw the creature trying to get into a pen in her garden where she kept domestic animals. "The bear lunged at the woman. The predator was shot dead by a neighbour of the deceased," TASS reported. Experts cited in Russian media said that bears — which have attacked humans in at least 11 regions across Russia this year and killed at least 20 people — have been forced to look further afield for food this year because an early and dry spring meant there was a lack of berries for them to feed on in September. People are also guilty of leaving food waste out in the open where it attracts bears and of ignoring safety rules, the experts said, while in at least one region the authorities stand accused of failing to keep bear numbers down. BEAR POPULATION HAS RISEN SHARPLY Shorter and milder winters, among other factors, have seen bear numbers more than double from 130,000 in 1990. Investigators in Krasnoyarsk, home to nearly 27,000 of Russia's 308,000 brown bears according to environment ministry data, said on Wednesday they had opened a criminal case into the local environment ministry, accusing it of negligence that led to the deaths of six people — now seven, including the woman in her garden — in the region in September alone. It said the ministry and other agencies had a responsibility to monitor and control the bear population and act promptly if people's lives were at risk. "Despite numerous warnings of danger, officials from the ministry and other authorised officials failed to take measures to regulate the predator population and prevent their appearance in areas inhabited by people," investigators said in a statement. "Monitoring data show that the brown bear population in the Krasnoyarsk region has increased 2.5-fold, reaching over 26,000 animals. Residents... have submitted more than 120 reports of brown bears entering the boundaries of settlements in more than 15 districts of the region, as well as in the cities of Krasnoyarsk, Zheleznogorsk and Zelenogorsk," they said. Investigators warned people to avoid visiting forests and to postpone any plans to go mushroom and berry picking in the woods, a popular Russian pastime. "If you encounter a large predator, you have virtually no chance of survival," the statement said. Other people killed by bears in the Krasnoyarsk region this month include a 39-year-old male logger and two women out picking mushrooms. OTHER REGIONS ALSO AFFECTED In Siberia's Irkutsk region, a male pensioner who also went out mushroom picking was killed by a bear this month as were two men gathering wild plants in a forest. In one of the most high-profile attacks this year, a bear attacked two tourists in their tent in the Altai region in August. It dragged one of the tourists, a 29-year-old woman, out of the tent, killed her, and then buried her in the forest. And in the Siberian region of Tuva, ice hockey coach Alexander Kuzmenko — father of NHL player Andrei Kuzmenko — was killed this week by a bear while on a fishing trip. The environment ministry has sought to play down the spate of attacks. "In recent years, around 20 to 30 cases of bear attacks have been recorded annually," it told the RBC news outlet. "The only abnormal spike was in 2014, when there were 166 cases. The thing is, nowadays everyone has a smartphone, and information spreads quickly via the internet and social media, which creates the impression that the problem is widespread."

item.title: EXCLUSIVE Ford F-150 truck production down for nearly a week at Michigan plant, memo says
item.description: Production of Ford Motor's most important vehicle, its F-150 pickup truck, is down for nearly a week at a Detroit-area plant, according to a memo viewed by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Nora Eckert
item.content:encoded: Production of Ford Motor's (F.N) most important vehicle, its F-150 pickup truck, is down for nearly a week at a Detroit-area plant, according to a memo viewed by Reuters. All production crews at Dearborn Truck Plant were canceled starting Thursday, through Tuesday, September 29, the memo said. Production of the F-150 truck at other plants was also affected. Ford's Kansas City Assembly Plant canceled some shifts this week due to the same issue impacting Dearborn, a person familiar with the matter said. Kentucky Truck Plant near Louisville increased truck production to make up for losses elsewhere, the person said.

item.title: Conta de luz pode voltar a ter bandeira verde em outubro, apontam análises
item.description: A conta de luz pode voltar a ter bandeira tarifária verde, sem cobrança adicional, em outubro, depois que as chuvas volumosas registradas em setembro ajudaram a diminuir os custos de geração de energia no país, segundo análises de especialistas do setor elétrico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A conta de luz pode voltar a ter bandeira tarifária verde, sem cobrança adicional, em outubro, depois que as chuvas volumosas registradas em setembro ajudaram a diminuir os custos de geração de energia no país, segundo análises de especialistas do setor elétrico. A bandeira tarifária para o próximo mês será anunciada na tarde desta sexta-feira pela Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel). Desde maio as contas de luz registram bandeira amarela, com uma cobrança adicional de R$1,885 na conta de luz, a cada 100 quilowatts-hora (kWh) consumidos. Em setembro, com o fim do alívio do bônus de Itaipu, o impacto da bandeira amarela na [USN:L1N45H0AN TEXT:"inflação"] foi mais sentido, conforme dados do IPCA-15 divulgados nesta sexta-feira. A Armor Energia, que atua com comercialização no mercado livre, disse em um boletim que setembro foi um dos meses mais chuvosos da série histórica no Sul e em importantes bacias do Sudeste. Isso favoreceu a geração hidrelétrica e ajudou a reduzir pressão sobre os custos de energia, apontou. Dados do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) vinham mostrando afluências bem acima da média de longo prazo em setembro no Sul, região que já começa a sentir reflexos do El Niño. O padrão climático, cuja intensidade neste ano pode ser uma das mais elevadas já registradas, costuma provocar no Brasil um aumento das chuvas no Sul e estiagens no Norte e Nordeste. A Armor prevê em seu cenário-base que a bandeira tarifária verde se manterá em novembro e dezembro deste ano. Cenário semelhante foi projetado pela Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE), em apresentação feita na semana passada. A CCEE também estima bandeira verde até o fim deste ano, com a conta de luz permanecendo sem taxa extra até abril de 2027.

item.title: Supreme Court restores Trump's mass voter verification system
item.description: The US Supreme Court revived on Friday an expanded immigration database that President Donald Trump's administration said aims to combat voting by noncitizens but critics contend could disenfranchise eligible voters.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court revived on Friday an expanded immigration database that President Donald Trump 's administration said aims to combat voting by noncitizens but critics contend could disenfranchise eligible voters. The justices granted the Justice Department's request to block a judge's order that had stopped state officials from using Social Security numbers and other information to conduct sweeping checks of the citizenship status of registered voters against federal records. The court has a 6-3 conservative majority. Its three liberal justices dissented from Friday's order. The majority said the plaintiffs' arguments likely fail because federal law expressly authorizes the Department of Homeland Security to request and receive information relating to citizenship and immigration status from other agencies, including the Social Security Administration. The administration's data-sharing arrangement is one in a series of actions boosting the federal government's involvement in voting ahead of November's midterm elections in which Trump's fellow Republicans seek to maintain control of Congress. The U.S. Constitution gives individual states the primary authority to run and administer elections. The Department of Homeland Security last year redesigned a federal database known as the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements, or SAVE, used to verify a person's citizenship and immigration status. The revamp allowed users to search many records at a time and to conduct searches using individuals' Social Security numbers. Since then, several Republican-led states have compared their voter lists to the database, and some voters flagged as potential noncitizens have had their registrations canceled. Critics say such election-related actions by Republicans are driven less by concerns over election security than by an attempt to gain political advantage by narrowing the electorate, risking the disenfranchisement of eligible, often Democratic-leaning voters. Trump has carried out hardline policies toward immigration and has made false claims of widespread voting fraud including in his 2020 election loss to Democratic former President Joe Biden. Advocacy groups that sued to block the revised SAVE system said that the new approach has resulted in people who were wrongfully identified as noncitizens being kicked off voter rolls. They have argued that SAVE can be outdated, meaning immigrants who have become naturalized US citizens and are thus eligible to vote are sometimes labeled as noncitizens. The modified system's overall error rate is not publicly known. The Department of Homeland Security and Justice Department did not provide that information when asked. Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington, which represents the plaintiffs, called Friday's decision "profoundly disappointing," saying it puts Americans "at risk of being unlawfully targeted by the administration's unreliable voter purge database weeks before the midterm elections." In a dissent on Friday that was joined by her two fellow liberal justices, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson wrote that "the harm caused by burdening or disenfranchising even a few lawful voters outweighs the nonexistent harm that the government experiences when it is prevented from taking an action that it likely lacks the authority to take." In their Supreme Court filing, the advocacy groups cited a Travis County, Texas, election official who said 25% of the system's noncitizen matches there involved people who had already proven their US citizenship, and news reports finding that at least 81% of the system's responses in St. Louis County, Missouri, were erroneous. The voting rights group League of Women Voters and privacy rights group Electronic Privacy Information Center sued in September 2025 to block the Trump administration's modified system. They said that the revamp violated federal privacy and other U.S. laws. In a June ruling blocking the revamped database, US District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan in Washington, D.C., said the system was haphazardly assembled and contained unreliable citizenship data. "All in all, the federal government has knowingly trampled on the privacy rights of American citizens in a manner that threatens the sacred right to vote," Sooknanan wrote. "This court cannot stand idly by while that happens." The US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit in a 2-1 ruling on September 4 declined to halt Sooknanan's ruling, prompting the administration's request to the Supreme Court. In a Supreme Court filing, Justice Department lawyers called the judge's order "indefensible," arguing that it "threatens the integrity" of the midterm elections. Texas, which intervened in the case in support of the administration, has disputed claims that the system is unreliable. Due to separate litigation in Florida, the Trump administration has been able to continue using its modified SAVE system in the Republican-led states of Florida, Iowa, Indiana and Ohio.

item.title: Gen Z is betting on AI skills to boost earning power
item.description: As AI reshapes entry-level work, young workers are using the technology to boost productivity, build portfolios and pursue new careers.
item.dc:creator: Hani Richter
item.content:encoded: Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft, says that being AI literate is one of the most important skills to leverage for her earning power. “The number of things and tasks that I can do, and the speed that I can do it at, ultimately increases and raises the way that I can create value to other people, to shareholders,” says the New York-based entrepreneur, whose fintech startup quantifAI helps users build and test trustworthy machine learning models. Antaya learned the basics of AI at university, where she studied mathematics and computer science. She started utilizing large language models like ChatGPT as soon as they came out, using it to predict Formula 1 races or forecast which team would win the Premier League. Antaya’s biggest use case, however, was for coding. After graduating in 2023, Antaya applied for dozens of jobs in the tech industry — including management, software engineering, and design roles — before landing an internship at Microsoft, where she worked on voice features and later built evaluation frameworks and tools for AI voice models. Now, she develops AI-focused products and shares how she created them online with her followers — skills that she says carry more value than credentials alone. “If you have an actual receipt of what you built and you're able to publish it online, other people are able to see it as useful proof,” she says. “That goes way further than any sort of little badge.” Antaya now uses AI to schedule tasks, draft replies to every single email in her inbox, analyze large volumes of data or gather webinar analytics from Zoom. Knowing how to use the technology will make you indispensable, she says. “That's what I did. And it has honestly led me to so many more opportunities than I could have ever imagined.” The Wider Trend Compared to older generations, young people tend to be more excited about the impact AI will have on their careers. A 2025 PwC survey of more than 2,000 young workers across the UK found that 67% of Gen Z expect AI to increase their productivity, while nearly half expect it to increase their salary and job security. Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Matthew Chancey, a certified financial planner and founder of Tax Alpha Companies, says free AI training can offer significant value. “Material that used to sit behind a tuition wall is now free, often published by the companies building the tools,” he says. When evaluating a course, Chancey recommends checking who created it, whether it’s current and, crucially, whether it results in a finished project rather than just a quiz. For those who decide to pay for training, Chancey recommends checking first whether your employer will cover the cost, noting that many employers offer these benefits, though workers seldom take advantage of them. Key Takeaways Invest time before spending money. AI upskilling can be a long-term career investment, with time often proving more valuable than tuition fees. Check whether your employer offers training support or educational benefits. Prioritize projects over certificates. Hands-on projects that improve workflows can carry more weight with employers. Turn higher earnings into long-term security. If AI helps boost your income, consider saving or investing the extra earnings before increasing your spending. Building an emergency fund, paying down debt, and contributing towards retirement can strengthen your financial position over time. Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

item.title: Japón dice que Trump mostró preocupación por debilidad del yen en cumbre con primera ministra Takaichi
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen en una cumbre con la primera ministra japonesa, Sanae Takaichi, según dijo el viernes la ministra de Hacienda Satsuki Katayama, quien ofreció un relato inusualmente detallado de las conversaciones entre ambos líderes sobre las divisas.
item.dc:creator: Makiko Yamazaki
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen en una cumbre con la primera ministra japonesa, Sanae Takaichi, según dijo el viernes la ministra de Hacienda Satsuki Katayama, quien ofreció un relato inusualmente detallado de las conversaciones entre ambos líderes sobre las divisas. "En la reciente cumbre entre Japón y Estados Unidos, el presidente Trump expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen", declaró Katayama en una rueda de prensa habitual, y añadió que revelaba este intercambio por primera vez tras consultar con la Oficina de la Primera Ministra. El relato franco de Katayama sobre las conversaciones entre los líderes, que los gobiernos suelen mantener en secreto, apunta a una preocupación compartida en Tokio y Washington por la continua caída del yen pese a su intervención conjunta en julio. En declaraciones a la prensa más tarde en el día, Takaichi confirmó los comentarios de Trump durante su reunión, que tuvo lugar el martes en Nueva York al margen de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas. "La parte estadounidense señaló que la debilidad del yen estaba creando dificultades para su comercio, y yo respondí que, como principio general, un yen infravalorado es problemático", afirmó. No obstante, subrayó que en la cumbre no se debatió sobre política monetaria ni fiscal, y añadió que la orientación de la política económica del Gobierno de Takaichi se mantiene sin cambios. Anteriormente, Takaichi había declarado a los periodistas que ella y Trump habían mantenido una conversación "oportuna" sobre China antes de la cumbre prevista entre el mandatario estadounidense y su par chino, Xi Jinping. Katayama señaló que el debate de los líderes sobre el mercado de divisas reafirmó la postura compartida por Washington y Tokio tras su intervención coordinada del 31 de julio, incluido el compromiso de contrarrestar la volatilidad excesiva y las fluctuaciones desordenadas del yen.

item.title: Primeira-dama da China exerce “soft power” sobre público dos EUA
item.description: Ela conversou com a primeira-dama dos Estados Unidos, Melania Trump, em inglês, sem a ajuda de um tradutor, e cantou baixinho quando foi presenteada com uma serenata por um coro de jovens, exibindo um glamour natural em uma versão moderna de um traje tradicional chinês.
item.dc:creator: Claire Fu, Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Ela conversou com a primeira-dama dos Estados Unidos, Melania Trump, em inglês, sem a ajuda de um tradutor, e cantou baixinho quando foi presenteada com uma serenata por um coro de jovens, exibindo um glamour natural em uma versão moderna de um traje tradicional chinês. Na viagem do presidente da China, Xi Jinping, a Washington, sua esposa, Peng Liyuan, é sua superarma de “soft power”, projetando uma imagem mais gentil e acessível da China, apesar das disputas com os Estados Unidos sobre tudo, desde o comércio até Taiwan. “Obrigado, mãe Peng!”, disseram as crianças do coro a ela, após apresentarem a canção folclórica chinesa “Flor de Jasmim” no Museu Nacional de Arte Asiática do Smithsonian, em Washington, na quinta-feira. O embaixador da China em Washington, Xie Feng, destacou o papel diplomático dela no X, postando um vídeo de Peng aplaudindo a apresentação. Peng “incentivou os adolescentes norte-americanos a continuarem estudando a língua e a cultura chinesas e a se tornarem embaixadores da amizade entre a China e os Estados Unidos”, escreveu Xie. “Ela ajuda a dar um tom mais humano ao que, de outra forma, poderia ser uma diplomacia bastante rígida, e a criar momentos agradáveis no que diz respeito às relações entre os EUA e a China”, disse Joe Mazur, analista de geopolítica da consultoria Trivium China, com sede em Pequim. O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China não respondeu a um pedido de comentário sobre a recepção a Peng em Washington. No entanto, as discussões nas redes sociais chinesas sobre suas atividades e escolhas de moda durante a viagem continuam bastante limitadas, o que ressalta a sensibilidade em relação à discussão pública sobre a vida pessoal dos principais líderes do país. Pesquisas sobre seu estilo de moda e suas habilidades em inglês na popular plataforma chinesa Red Note não geraram resultados. As esposas dos principais líderes chineses têm, tradicionalmente, mantido um perfil discreto nas últimas décadas, devido à experiência de Jiang Qing, viúva do fundador da China comunista, Mao Zedong. Jiang, líder da infame “Gangue dos Quatro” que exerceu poder supremo durante a Revolução Cultural, de 1966 a 1976, recebeu uma sentença de morte suspensa em 1981 pelas mortes de dezenas de milhares de pessoas durante aquele período de caos. Peng era anteriormente mais conhecida na China como soprano do Exército. À medida que Xi ascendia ao poder no início dos anos 2000, a mídia chinesa passou a ter mais liberdade para cobrir as atividades dela. “Quando ele chega em casa, nunca pensei nisso como se houvesse algum líder na casa. Aos meus olhos, ele é apenas meu marido”, disse Peng em uma entrevista a uma revista estatal em 2007. Ela descreveu Xi como frugal, trabalhador e com os pés no chão. De origem humilde, Peng tem defendido causas sociais complexas, como a das pessoas que vivem com HIV/AIDS. Peng é a segunda esposa de Xi, e os dois têm uma filha que estudou em Harvard. Xi se divorciou de sua primeira esposa, filha de um diplomata. (Reportagem de Claire Fu e Ben Blanchard; Reportagem adicional de Mei Mei Chu)

item.title: Sri Lanka's parliament approves constitutional amendment to extend judge terms
item.description: Sri Lanka's parliament approved an amendment to the island nation's constitution on Friday to extend superior court judges' tenure by two years as part of measures to clear a large backlog of cases and reduce prisoner numbers after deadly prison riots.
item.dc:creator: Uditha Jayasinghe
item.content:encoded: Sri Lanka's parliament approved an amendment to the island nation's constitution on Friday to extend superior court judges' tenure by two years as part of measures to clear a large backlog of cases and reduce prisoner numbers after deadly prison riots. Delayed proceedings, which often drag on for years, have fuelled a crisis across Sri Lanka's prison network, where 22 facilities built for about 11,000 inmates now hold more than 41,000 — including thousands of remand prisoners yet to be tried. The move follows two recent prison riots that killed [USN:L4N43C0GA TEXT:"31 people"], including 10 prison officials, and injured dozens more. The amendment seeks to reduce a backlog of an estimated 1.1 million court cases, according to the country's justice ministry. The 22nd amendment to Sri Lanka's constitution was approved with a two-thirds majority by the 225-member house. The constitutional amendment will extend the tenure of Supreme Court, Appeals Court and High Court judges and of the Chief Justice by two years each. A separate draft bill to extend the tenure of district and magistrate judges by two years was approved as well. Bimal Rathnayake, Leader of the House, told lawmakers ahead of the vote: "This constitutional amendment is purely to support judicial reforms. This is why there isn't any significant protest from the masses." Sri Lanka's main opposition, the Samagi Jana Balawegaya, wore black to parliament and protested the amendment, contending that it undermined judicial independence.

item.title: Monedas caen y perfilan semana de descensos ante expectativas alzas tasas Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina caían el viernes y se encaminaban a acumular bajas semanales, en medio de las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina caían el viernes y se encaminaban a acumular bajas semanales, en medio de las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * Pese a que el dólar descendía en la jornada, junto con los precios del petróleo, el billete verde marchaba hacia su segunda ganancia semanal consecutiva, ante el reajuste de los mercados de las perspectivas sobre alzas de tasas por parte de la Fed, debido principalmente al avance de los precios de la energía. * "Parte de esta corrección a la baja del dólar está explicada por un retroceso de los precios de energéticos, lo que modera el riesgo de presiones inflacionarias globales", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * Los precios del crudo descendían en la sesión ante expectativas de que Estados Unidos e Irán puedan lograr un acuerdo que reabra el estrecho de Ormuz. * Mientras, varias autoridades monetarias de la Fed han expresado su disposición a aumentar el costo del crédito más adelante si las presiones sobre los precios no remiten de la forma esperada. En la sesión, además, los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro subían nuevamente, amortiguando el descenso del dólar. * El peso mexicano bajaba un ligero 0,04%, a 17,7252 unidades por dólar, en su cuarta sesión de descensos y encaminándose a su peor semana desde marzo; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, subía un 0,59%, a 64.640,88 puntos, apuntando a un alza semanal. * El real brasileño cedía un 0,29% a 5,2077 por dólar, mientras que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) perdía un 0,85%, a 182,407 puntos, presionada por las acciones de Petrobras ante la baja de los precios del petróleo y la nueva alza de los retornos de los bonos estadounidenses. * Los mercados de Brasil seguían pendientes también de las elecciones presidenciales locales de inicios de octubre. * Un sondeo de Datafolha divulgado la noche del jueves mostró al presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva 2 puntos por sobre su rival de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro, en una hipotética segunda vuelta, aunque la diferencia se encuentra dentro del margen de error de la muestra, por lo que ambos se encuentran prácticamente empatados. * El peso chileno , bajaba un 0,75%, a 966,20/966,50 unidades por dólar, mientras que el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) retrocedía un 0,17%, a 11.278,13 puntos. * Mientras, el peso colombiano se recuperaba un 0,79% a 3.323 unidades por dólar, tras una seguidilla de nueves jornadas de pérdidas; mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) retrocedía un 0,98% a 2.583,73 puntos. * El peso argentino interbancario se depreciaba un 0,23% a 1.523,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, con regulación de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA). Mientras que el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires moderaba sus pérdidas de más un 1% más temprano y retrocedía un 0,57%, tras acumular hasta el jueves una caída de 3,97% en cinco rondas seguidas. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un 0,06% a 3,4120/3,4180 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) avanzaba un 0,31% a 1.581,83 puntos.

item.title: Preço mais alto da energia desafia atratividade do mercado livre no Brasil
item.description: Preços mais altos de energia elétrica no Brasil diminuíram a economia potencial para consumidores que queiram aderir ao mercado livre, um cenário que tende a permanecer e pode pesar sobre a atratividade do segmento no processo de liberalização a todos os consumidores do país, a partir do fim de 2027 e 2028, de acordo com empresas do ramo.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: Preços mais altos de energia elétrica no Brasil diminuíram a economia potencial para consumidores que queiram aderir ao mercado livre, um cenário que tende a permanecer e pode pesar sobre a atratividade do segmento no processo de liberalização a todos os consumidores do país, a partir do fim de 2027 e 2028, de acordo com empresas do ramo. As comercializadoras de energia ainda apostam em crescimento do mercado, que passará da casa dos milhares para milhões de consumidores nos próximos anos, mas apontam que o fator "preço" pode reduzir a velocidade das adesões, a exemplo do que já acontece com os clientes aptos ao mercado livre. Os descontos ofertados para entrada no mercado livre de energia, que há três anos podiam chegar a 40% frente aos preços do mercado regulado, atendidos pelas distribuidoras, hoje estão em menos de 10%, apontam executivos do setor. "Lá em 2023 a gente conseguia fazer contratos de R$100 a R$150 o megawatt-hora. Hoje, para 2027, ele gira em torno da faixa de R$300", disse Maikon Del Ré Perin, especialista em risco e inteligência de mercado da Ludfor, que também atua com comercialização varejista. A [USN:L1N41O0TQ TEXT:"disparada dos preços de energia"] veio desde 2025, sobretudo após ajustes nos modelos de precificação que tornaram o sistema brasileiro mais avesso a risco. Em paralelo, o fim de um desconto a energias renováveis no uso das redes também aumentou os custos dessas fontes, impactando os valores cobrados em novos contratos entre comercializadoras e consumidores. O "varejo" elétrico, composto por pequenas e médias empresas, cresceu aceleradamente depois da eliminação, em 2024, de barreiras para adesão ao mercado livre. Mas boa parte do mercado potencial já se esgotou, fazendo com que as migrações recuassem 34% de janeiro a julho deste ano ante igual período de 2025, segundo dados da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE). Ainda segundo Perin, os descontos possíveis para 2027 frente ao mercado regulado estão entre 5% e 10%, contra 40% há alguns anos. Ele pondera, no entanto, que esse cenário pode mudar para melhor, principalmente se as chuvas forem favoráveis à geração hidrelétrica -- a hidrologia é um fator relevante para os preços de energia no Brasil.
